page.overview:
What is Oriab?

Oriab is a fictional location in the Cthulhu Mythos. It was originally created by the late American author H. P. Lovecraft for his novella The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath, depicted as being a large island located in the Southern Sea of the Dreamlands.

Every month the people of Oriab trade "fragrant resin of Oriab’s inner groves, and the delicate pottery baked by the artists of Baharna, and the strange little figures carved from Ngranek’s ancient lava. For this they were paid in the wool of Ulthar and the iridescent textiles of Hatheg and the ivory that the black men carve across the river in Parg".
